events.text: Veltroni resigned as leader of the party after being elected Mayor of Rome.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 2001 , Veltroni resigned as leader of the party after being elected Mayor of Rome .

events.text: Veltroni was confirmed Mayor of Rome, easily defeating Gianni Alemanno.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In May 2006 , Veltroni was confirmed Mayor of Rome , easily defeating former Minister of Agriculture Gianni Alemanno

events.text: As mayor of Rome, he met in Washington then United States Senator Barack Obama.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 2005 , as mayor of Rome , he met in Washington , during a visit to the United States , then United States Senator ( D-IL ) , Barack Obama

events.text: He wrote the preface to the Italian edition of The Audacity of Hope.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He wrote the preface to the Italian edition of The Audacity of Hope in 2007

events.text: DS leader Piero Fassino publicly asked Veltroni to run for the party leadership.
events.subject: other
events.quote: In June 2007 , DS leader Piero Fassino publicly asked Veltroni to run for the party leadership

events.text: Veltroni was elected as the first leader of the newly founded Democratic Party.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Veltroni was elected as the first leader of the newly founded Democratic Party on 14 October 2007

events.text: Veltroni had some remarks against the Romanian immigrants.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 2007 , Veltroni had some remarks against the Romanian immigrants

events.text: Veltroni led the Democratic Party into the April 2008 general election.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Veltroni led the Democratic Party into the April 2008 general election

events.text: Veltroni resigned as Mayor of Rome to concentrate on the campaign.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Veltroni resigned as Mayor of Rome on 13 February 2008 to concentrate on the campaign

events.text: Veltroni announced his immediate resignation from his leadership post.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 17 February 2009 , following clashes within the party and only a day after a heavy defeat of the Democratic Party in a local regional election in Sardinia , Veltroni announced his immediate resignation from his leadership post

events.text: The Constituent Assembly of the party convened and elected Dario Franceschini as the new secretary.
events.subject: other
events.quote: The Constituent Assembly of the party subsequently convened on 21 February 2009 and elected Veltronis former deputy Dario Franceschini as the new secretary
